clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
Executive Orber.
Fourth-class postmasters having been classified in certain States and
time being necessarily required before any positions in such offices can be
filled by examination and certification from the Civil Service Commission,
any vacancy in such post offices occurring prior to the time at which the
Civil Service Commission shall certify to the Post Office Department that
it is able to hold examinations and make certifications to such positions,
may he filled by the Post Office Department without examination.

ACTOR_TEXT:EO:1776.text:
May 7, 1913.
The list of classified positions excepted from examination under civil-service Rule
11, clause 3, is hereby amended so as to omit the position of chief post-office inspector
in the Post Office Department.
The effect of the above order was to restore the position of post-office inspector to
the competitive class. The position was transferred from the excepted to the com-
petitive class by the revision of the rules on May 6, 1896. It was placed in the
excepted class by the order of January 4, 1910.
